integrity: Analytic proof plus standalone finite exact-rational and high-precision numerical checks. Historical originality is best-knowledge, not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Holomorphic homogeneous fixed-degree subspaces only; fixed-k large-degree asymptotic. No statement for nonholomorphic harmonics or growing k. The general torus-invariant Toeplitz diagonalization is prior art.
title: Sharp coordinate-dominance concentration for holomorphic spherical polynomials
